newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA-C.BANK CHIEF SAYS JP MORGAN EYES T-BILL MARKET.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA-C.BANK CHIEF SAYS JP MORGAN EYES T-BILL MARKET.

text.p: Lithuanian central bank govenor Reinoldijus Sharkinas said on Wednesday that investment bank JP Morgan was eyeing the local T-bill market.
"JP Morgan is interested in our T-bill market," Sharkinas told Reuters after he met with representatives from the bank, which has been named to lead Lithuania's upcoming $200 million Eurobond issue.
Yields on Lithuanian debt paper are currently in the 10.50 to 11.50 percent range.
"It is also very interested in how our bank will pursue monetary policy after the currency board is scrapped," he said.
Lithuania plans to gradually dismantle its currency board model, by which the litas is pegged to the dollar at a rate of four to one, over a two to three year period.
Sharkinas added that JP Morgan showed little interest in the privatisation of the state-run State Commercial and Agricultural banks.
